subtitle: Lesson 24 · Security Administration with T-SQL

code:
-- Every login on the instance (in master)
SELECT name, type_desc, is_disabled
FROM sys.server_principals
WHERE type IN ('S', 'U', 'G');

-- Every user in the CURRENT database
SELECT name, type_desc, default_schema_name
FROM sys.database_principals
WHERE type IN ('S', 'U', 'G');
caption: A login gets you onto the instance. A user is what it maps to inside one database.

eyebrow: Mapping users back to their login
code:
SELECT
    dp.name AS database_user,
    sp.name AS server_login,
    dp.type_desc
FROM sys.database_principals dp
LEFT JOIN sys.server_principals sp
    ON dp.sid = sp.sid
WHERE dp.type IN ('S', 'U', 'G');
caption: A NULL server_login means an orphaned user — Lesson 26.
